fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read ship-change.toml, review.toml, internal/api/ship.go (ship check and its once-per-head rerun of failed jobs) and the model (milestone-25, #259's change set and its serves decision). It raised one question covering four topics (which intent it serves, the mechanism, which stages fix, the cap). The arbiter answered with Decision ship-change-ci-fix-cycle: serve milestone-25. ship check keeps its flake rerun, then parses failing tests from gh run view --log-failed into findings with no leaf; anything unparsable still fails as today. A ci-fix fixer step runs on pr-green and rebased-green failures, at most 2 cycles per run, and returns through render-pr, open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green and signoff. landed-green and rebased-merge-green are unchanged. The planner wrote two leaves under wait-green-pr: test-failure findings in ship check, and the ci-fix step and its routing.
fields.title: Plan of Ship-change fixes red PR CI (autonomous)
